name: Collision-Free Subset Framing
description: Replaces the textbook "exact cover" wording ("utilized exactly once") with an "independent set" wording ("subset of exactly k profiles", "mutually collision-free"). Since the identifiers are bounded by k, choosing k collision-free profiles mathematically implies an exact cover, but models relying on pattern-matching will likely attempt a generic backtracking search over the t profiles (which TLEs) rather than branching optimally on the k dimensions.
